title: Task tools find a task record that lives only in its lane worktree
body:
Why: logic audit + observed today: src/cli/lane.ts:316 moves an uncommitted task record into the lane and deletes it from the source checkout; lane run rerun reads the brief from root (lane-run.ts:334) and gets 'Unknown task'; lane drop (:230) worktree remove --force destroys the only copy; krn pr body --task from the root failed the same way for a task created in a lane.
Outcome: one task lookup resolves the claim's worktree before the root; lane drop refuses (or rescues the record) when the worktree holds the only copy.
Proof: tests for pr body, lane run rerun and drop with a worktree-only record.
Scope: src/task/, src/cli/, test/.
